recipes.name: Banana Bread in a Mug
instructions: In a microwave-safe mug, mash the banana with a fork. Then add the milk, oil, vanilla, and salt and mix.
Add the flour, flaxseeds, sugar, chocolate, and baking powder and mix until just incorporated. Be careful not to over-mix.

Microwave at high power (800 - 900 W) for 2 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into the centre comes out clean*. If the cake isn't cooked through yet, cook at intervals of 15 seconds until done. Add your desired toppings and enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † We use 50 - 60% cocoa chocolate for a balanced sweetness. Darker varieties (70%+) can make the result too bitter. * The cooking time may vary depending on your microwave and settings. If preferred, bake it in an oven-safe baking dish in the oven at 350°F (180°C) for 15 to 25 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the centre comes out clean.
Storage This dessert is best enjoyed immediately.
